findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A model may open spec.md on its own and find the section, but the nudge explicitly enumerates one heading and a model follows the enumerated path, so the failure is reachable.
findingDetails.case: A relaunch of a session bound to a packet whose spec.md states its purpose in ## ROOT PURPOSE or ## PURPOSE with no ### Purpose heading: the model follows the nudge, finds no enumerated section, and omits the line or falls through to the goal objective, while resume, compaction and the continuity save carry it. With an ancestor purpose, the nudge also omits the repo-relative definition of <parent folder>.
findingDetails.claim: The relaunch hop purpose rule enumerates a strict subset of the heading shapes the other three hops and the shared reader support, and drops the repo-relative parent-folder definition.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the final nudge text, its test and the sibling assets; looked for a comment or test declaring the relaunch hop intentionally narrower. None found, and the same change f9f96bdc39 widened the other hops, so the narrower text is an omission rather than a contract.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A test or comment stating the relaunch hop intentionally supports only ## PROBLEM & PURPOSE and does not require a repo-relative parent label.
findingDetails.recommendation: Make the nudge heading list and parent-label definition match handoff.md:136-137 and the resume assets, and add the ## PURPOSE and ## ROOT PURPOSE shapes to nudge.test.cjs.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read all four hop assets and the shared reader: the resume YAMLs name PROBLEM & PURPOSE, PURPOSE and ROOT PURPOSE (speckit-resume-auto.yaml:139, speckit-resume-confirm.yaml:158), handoff.md:136 names all three and handoff.md:137 defines the parent folder as repo-relative, packet-purpose.ts:42 matches all three, and nudge.cjs:27-28 names only PROBLEM & PURPOSE while nudge.cjs:30 omits the repo-relative definition. nudge.test.cjs:109 asserts only the ### Purpose and label strings, so the gap is untested.
findingDetails.title: Relaunch purpose rule is narrower than the shared hop rule

findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The Pi state may in practice hold only proper packet folders, making the gap latent rather than observed; the code path still diverges from the sibling hook on a shape the shared state permits.
findingDetails.case: A Pi session whose recorded lastSpecFolder is a packet subfolder (for example specs/<track>/<leaf>/scratch) or a track folder without spec.md: the Pi compaction resolves that folder, finds no spec.md, and resolvePacketPurpose's ancestor walk stops at the non-phase-parent leaf, so no Packet Purpose section is injected; the same state on Claude walks up to the nearest folder holding spec.md and carries the purpose.
findingDetails.claim: The Pi compaction hook receives the same lastSpecFolder shape as Claude but lacks the nearest-spec.md walk-up, so a subfolder-shaped value loses the purpose on Pi only.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether resolvePacketPurpose's ancestor walk already covers a leaf subfolder (it only climbs phase parents) and whether Pi reads a different state field (it reads the same lastSpecFolder file). The e129 commit comment itself names the track-folder and scratch/research-subfolder shapes the walk-up was added for.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A state-writer guarantee or test proving Pi's lastSpecFolder always holds a folder with spec.md (or a phase parent), or a Pi test showing the hook walks to the packet.
findingDetails.recommendation: Share one folder-to-packet resolver with the nearest-spec.md walk-up between the Claude and Pi compaction hooks, with a subfolder fixture in hook-precompact.vitest.ts.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read both compaction call sites and the shared reader: session-prime.ts:236-243 walks up while <folder>/spec.md does not exist, while session-compact-context.ts:80-86 calls resolvePacketPurpose(folder) directly; packet-purpose.ts:154-162 only climbs ancestors that have spec.md AND are phase parents, so a leaf subfolder is not covered. Both hooks read the same lastSpecFolder field: session-compact-context.ts:52-61 reads the shared hook-state file, and session-stop.ts:542 writes detectedSpec.specFolder.
findingDetails.title: Pi compaction skips the nearest-spec.md walk-up the Claude compaction uses

findingDetails.case: A purpose sentence whose 297th UTF-16 code unit is the high half of a non-BMP character: sentence.length and slice count code units, so the appended ellipsis leaves a lone surrogate, rendered as U+FFFD, and the carried sentence is one code point short of the 300-character contract.
findingDetails.recommendation: Slice by code points (Array.from) or back off one code unit when the boundary falls on a high surrogate before appending the ellipsis.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The cap and slice are used at this one site (MAX_PURPOSE_CHARS at packet-purpose.ts:38 and the slice at :115); the other hops copy model-emitted text and are not affected by this code path.
findingDetails.title: The 300-character purpose cut can split a surrogate pair
